# 💫 About Me:
Hi, I'm Krish Rawal 👋<br><br>I'm a Frontend & Mobile Developer from Ahmedabad, India. I build fast, responsive web apps with React and TypeScript, and cross-platform mobile apps with React Native and Expo.<br><br>🔭 Currently building: File-Sharing-App, GujaratLandSurvey, MyTodoApp<br>🌱 Currently learning: Expo Router, native modules, app performance<br>📱 I love turning ideas into apps that work on web, Android and iOS
